tokenizer.name: t5-small
tokenizer.forced_eos_rule: Apply the exact CPBD/Collator left-truncation and forced-EOS rule independently to each 64-token branch.

serializations.cf_stream: item: <link>; similar items: <same fixed CF identities>
serializations.future_grouping: Concatenate the two encoded 64-token hidden-state tensors inside one item group; both inherit the same item position and receive different source embeddings.

budget_definition.primary: Padded tensor width and decoder cross-attention capacity: 64 + 64 = 128 per historical item.
budget_definition.not_required: Short inputs are not required to contain 128 active non-padding tokens.
budget_definition.descriptive_confound: Active-token difference and the second EOS token are reported descriptively and must be controlled in J1.

decision_rule.execution_invalid: Any catalog, parsing, finite, component, width, link-duplication or exact-current-replay integrity gate fails.
decision_rule.stop_budget_infeasible: Either dataset fails any CF/key-metadata/metadata-gain feasibility gate.
decision_rule.j1_design_allowed: All integrity and feasibility gates pass on both datasets.

forbidden: checkpoint loading, model scoring, training or GPU
validation/test targets, predictions, hit/miss or beam ranks
alternative 32/96, 48/80, 80/48 or dynamic budgets after census
using one dataset to rescue failure on the other
